title: Executable binary dot product
statement: Let $\ell$ be a nonnegative integer and let $a,b\in\mathbb{F}_2^\ell$, where $\mathbb{F}_2$ is the field with two elements. The executable binary dot product of $a$ and $b$ equals their dot product over $\mathbb{F}_2$.
